question: Do the W-SYN01 slope-block controls replicate under four new, independently frozen paired synthetic seeds at precisely the same sampling/capacity budget?
hypothesis: Four of four new seed pairs satisfy preregistered W-SYN01 directional slope-gap and matching baseline parity criteria at exactly unchanged capacity; failures retained as negative or mixed.
predecessor_evidence: W-SYN01 separately frozen primary at c8b8b41dc500678ba4caf1f40f86c7d2daeaa386, superseded by pre-primary infrastructure freeze at 04b1091f1d3c7f602e5850cb419e9bcff5b07827; original exact executed source 610b8d380f2da6dd5517c8aa39f4607b7e3bd627.

Original W-SYN01 primary scientific result: GitHub run 37942093421; raw result SHA256 c8ac40419f412d494c87ad9441fddea357df38dbd3cb1f76a668c9a6f59bb557; synthetic-only SUPPORTED on old seeds; no reuse of old seeds as newly unseen.

inputs.name: W-SYN02 fresh synthetic seed replication
inputs.source: Exact W-SYN01 generator/arms/regimes unchanged; 4 new training and heldout seeds disjoint with W-SYN01: 211,223,227,229 and 307,311,313,317.
inputs.sha_state: Freeze this prereg alone before implementing or looking at new heldout outputs. Later fix exact source SHA and qualified workflow separately.

frozen_design.seed_pairing: one-to-one in listed order; do not pick seeds after outcomes
frozen_design.generator: Unsigned 32-bit xorshift32: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5, 32-bit truncation after each operation. Initialize x=(seed xor 0x9E3779B9 xor (regime_index+1)*0x85EBCA6B) modulo 2^32, replace zero with 1. Consume six u32 for each row raw[j]=2*u32/2^32-1; transformed state[j]=raw[j]*alpha[j]. Consume seventh u32 for additive label noise noise=0.20*(u32/2^32-0.5). Label y=0.2+dot(state,regime coefficients)+noise. Train and heldout use separate seeds.
frozen_design.training_algorithm: Per arm use the qualified research/r53prefreeze DesignRow API; form 7x7 normal equations on exactly 436 training rows and response values, add fixed ridge penalty 0.1 to active slope diagonal entries (none to intercept), solve with deterministic Gaussian elimination/pivot rule (smallest eligible row on equal pivot; reject near-zero pivots <1e-12). Inactive theta slots zero. No training on heldout.
frozen_design.compute_budget: At most 35 million elementary scalar arithmetic operations, fixed four regimes, four seed pairs and four arms; no retries that multiply data budget.
frozen_design.capacity: Exactly six state dimensions; <=7 effective readout coefficients including single intercept; 0 additional learned state and 0 model/tokenizer calls
frozen_design.metric: Heldout mean squared prediction error per arm, regime and seed pair; fixed seed-wise comparison, no pooled winner selection
frozen_design.reference_mechanism: Frozen W-SYN01 source contains unchanged qualified Wingless R53 mechanism (original PR #21). No modification to r53prefreeze. Use the exact external frozen R205 implementation as the algorithmic parent.
frozen_design.evaluator_access: Only new 307/311/313/317 heldout seeds after immutable W-SYN02 prereg freeze, independent exact code SHA qualification and CKB one-shot research admission. R205 heldout seeds must not be accessed.

controls: A0 untied six slope equal budget control
A3 original R52 early/late two-group comparator
neither-tied and both-tied regimes deliberately challenge asymmetric tying
metrics: mse per arm per regime per seed

classification_rules.supported: For all 4 frozen seed pairs, early-only A2_MSE-A1_MSE >= 0.01 AND late-only A1_MSE-A2_MSE >= 0.01 AND matching A1 and A2 MSE <= A0 MSE + 0.01 on their respective regimes
classification_rules.mixed: No INVALID condition and both directional gaps reach >=0.01 for at least 2 but fewer than 4 of the fixed seed pairs OR only one direction reaches four of four
classification_rules.negative: No INVALID condition, and neither SUPPORTED nor MIXED rule holds; keep all per-arm error and no post-result retune
classification_rules.invalid: Any missing or drifted prereg/code/controller binding; heldout inspection before freeze; seed/arm/cohort/budget drift; impossible or nonfinite output; solver failure; retry, capacity or authority overrun

prohibited_after_primary_run: relabeling negative or mixed as infra failure
